title: Clip
$comment: I will likely add a separate network_clip schema to add support for compression. This could embed the Clip and add an extra field.

id.description: The unique ID of the Clip in the daemon.

mime_type.description: The MIME type of the data within.

is_text.description: Whether the clip data is text.

data.description: The data of the clip. If is_text is false, then this shall be base64 encoded.
